section: International - treaties, agreements and developments in international organisations

accepted.s:
With reference to the BBNJ or High Seas Treaty, consider the following statements:
1. It was adopted in March 2023.
2. It entered into force on 17 January 2026.
3. India has ratified the treaty.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The BBNJ Treaty was adopted in March 2023 and entered into force on 17 January 2026. India has signed but not ratified it.
accepted.tq: Find the incorrect accession-status statement; signing and ratification are distinct stages.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: India's status regarding the BBNJ or High Seas Treaty is that it has
accepted.x: India has signed the BBNJ Treaty but has not ratified it.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the closely related treaty stages of signature and ratification.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the UN Convention against Cybercrime is correct?
o: India signed it at Hanoi in October 2025.
India did not sign it, citing concerns relating to privacy and data sovereignty.
India ratified it immediately after its adoption in December 2024.
It was negotiated under the International Civil Aviation Organization.
accepted.x: India did not sign the UN Convention against Cybercrime because of concerns relating to privacy and data sovereignty.
accepted.tq: Use the country-status and stated-reason trap in an international agreement question.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the UN Convention against Cybercrime:
1. It is described as the first global cybercrime treaty.
2. It was adopted through UN General Assembly Resolution 79/243 in December 2024.
3. It was opened for signature at Hanoi in October 2025.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The Convention is the first global cybercrime treaty, was adopted through Resolution 79/243 in December 2024, and opened for signature at Hanoi in October 2025.
accepted.tq: Check each date, venue and institutional description separately before selecting the coded combination.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The UN Convention against Cybercrime becomes binding how many days after the deposit of the 40th ratification?
accepted.x: The Convention becomes binding 90 days after 40 ratifications have been deposited.
accepted.tq: Recall the threshold-and-time-period pair rather than confusing it with the signature stage.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The secretariat of the UN Convention against Cybercrime is to be provided by
accepted.x: The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) serves as the secretariat of the Convention against Cybercrime.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Water Convention:
1. It was adopted at Helsinki in 1992.
2. It entered into force in 1996.
3. It concerns transboundary rivers and lakes.
4. Bangladesh became the first South Asian party.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The Helsinki Water Convention was adopted in 1992, entered into force in 1996, concerns transboundary waters, and Bangladesh was the first South Asian party.
accepted.tq: Verify the place, dates, subject and regional accession status independently.

accepted.s: The Washington Accords, signed on 4 December 2025, concern
o: the regulation of high seas biodiversity
trade between the United Kingdom and the European Union
peace between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda
accepted.x: The Washington Accords are a United States-brokered peace agreement between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda.
accepted.tq: Use the parties-and-purpose approach to distinguish similarly named international agreements.

accepted.s: The Windsor Framework is associated with
o: UK-EU arrangements on Northern Ireland trade
the conservation of high seas biodiversity

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Convention on Nuclear Safety — India became a party in 2016
Convention on Supplementary Compensation — India became a party in 2016
Convention on Supplementary Compensation — adopted in 1997; entered into force in 2015
Convention on Nuclear Safety — adopted in 1994; entered into force in 1996
accepted.x: India is a party to the Convention on Nuclear Safety, but the 2016 accession detail applies to the Convention on Supplementary Compensation (CSC).
accepted.tq: Find the swapped date or status in a set of closely related nuclear conventions.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: With reference to the five United Nations outer-space treaties, which one of the following is correct regarding India?
o: India has ratified all five but signed only four.
India has signed and ratified all five.
India has signed all five and ratified four, but not the Moon Agreement of 1979.
India has neither signed nor ratified the Moon Agreement but has ratified only three others.
accepted.x: India has signed all five UN outer-space treaties and ratified four. The exception is the 1979 Moon Agreement, which India has not ratified.
accepted.tq: Separate the complete signature record from the incomplete ratification record.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the Montreal Protocol is correct?
o: It was replaced by the Chicago Convention in 2026.
It has been ratified by 90 parties and is not universally ratified.
It has been ratified by 197 parties and is universally ratified.
India will stop all HFC production immediately under the original protocol.
accepted.x: The Montreal Protocol is universally ratified by 197 parties. India is to stop clearances for new HFC production beyond 31 December 2027 under the Kigali Amendment.
accepted.tq: Use the ratification-count and universal-status clue while rejecting unrelated treaty substitutions.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the Kigali Amendment, India will stop clearances for new HFC production beyond
accepted.x: India will stop clearances for new hydrofluorocarbon production beyond 31 December 2027 under the Kigali Amendment.
accepted.tq: Recall the precise deadline rather than the year of adoption of the parent protocol.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: In India, treaties are concluded in the name of the
accepted.x: Treaties concluded by India are concluded in the name of the President. Article 253 empowers Parliament to legislate for their implementation.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who performs this constitutional function?’ method.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Article 253 of the Constitution of India enables Parliament to
o: appoint the secretariat of every UN convention
ratify every treaty without executive action
withdraw India from any treaty without consultation
legislate for implementing treaties and international agreements
accepted.x: Article 253 empowers Parliament to make laws for implementing treaties, agreements and conventions with foreign countries or decisions made at international conferences.
accepted.tq: Apply the constitutional provision to the practical task of treaty implementation.
accepted.sec: Treaties and agreements signed - parties, subject, India's accession status  [APPSC]

Consider the following statements regarding the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA):

3. The EFTA countries are Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland.
